description: This Java class defines a utility for managing API request context using ThreadLocal storage. It provides methods to retrieve or initialize the context and to clear it, ensuring thread-safe storage of request-specific data.

classes.name: ApiRequestContextHolder
classes.description: A utility class providing thread-local storage for API request contexts, with methods to get, set, and clear the context.

methods.name: clearContext
methods.description: Removes the current thread's API request context from ThreadLocal storage.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's API request context, creating a new one if it does not exist, and logs the creation event.
